mechanics.premise: Benevolence is grounded in a spontaneous reaction to suffering, and the response must be extended from the near case to the distant (dossier section E).
tone_mechanisms_observed: child-at-the-well: spontaneous alarm and compassion in anyone who sees a child about to fall into a well, independent of advantage or reputation (2A6) (dossier section E)
compassion as the sprout of ren: the incipient capacity to be cultivated rather than assumed (6A6) (dossier sections A, E)
extension from near to distant: the king's compassion for an ox must be extended to his suffering subjects (1A7) (dossier sections E, F)
mechanics.emotional_progression: Spontaneous alarm in a concrete near case, then deliberate extension of concern to the more distant sufferer (dossier section E).
mechanics.style_and_devices: Begins from a concrete near case and extends outward - a narrative theory of moral attention usable for extending the reader's concern (dossier section E).
mechanics.scope_note: Ren is recorded as a broader virtue than the English 'compassion', bound to a Confucian role ethic, and must not be universalized into a generic compassion (dossier sections E, I); the dossier states no publisher for the Van Norden translation, so none was added.
mechanics.verification_note: Van Norden trans. 2008 and SEP 2024 confirm passages 2A6, 6A6, 1A7; described, not quoted (dossier section F).
